items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Uh-huh' to the interviewer's narration about T-Bone and Charlie Parker; no direct interaction or personal relationship between Kenny Clarke and T-Bone is stated.

ctx.x: Didn't -- it seemed to me, you know -- T-Bone told me, because they -- T-Bone was in Dallas and Charlie was in Oklahoma City --
